dogecoin.text: Who wants @Tesla to accept #DogeCoins as currency in reality? #dogecoin @elonmusk
The price of @dogecoin jumped after Musk said he is working with developers of meme-inspired digital currency.

Elon Musk also helped to whipsaw #dogecoin prices after tweeting he's working with developers of #shibainucoin-themed token to improve transaction efficiencies. Dip in Tesla shares widely seen caused by global slump in technology stocks as well as due to alleged troubles in Tesla
